verdict.rationale: v0 explicitly claims the API gives 'programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities' including chat, project management, and deployment (v0-docs-4), backed by SDK examples (v0-gh-1/2/3) and API docs on GitHub import and export (v0-docs-37, v0-docs-43). However, many UI-specific workflows (Figma/screenshot cloning, CI/conflict-fix buttons, command palette search, iOS app, visual style controls) are only documented as UI features with no API equivalent shown, and no independent test confirms true 1:1 parity. missing for 10: API-exposed equivalents for design import (Figma/screenshots), GitHub PR/CI-fix actions, and independent verification that API surface matches UI feature set.
